messages:
Tom: Quick heads-up — bringing silkroad-v1 through q4f onboarding. Short smoke shows invisible separators (NBSP/ZWNJ) and occasional punctuation mirror in mixed CJK+RTL lines. FP16 clean; q4f BLEU down ~5 on our srt-multilang subset. Anyone seen compaction/hash issues cause these? :confused:

Aiko: Can you paste a minimal repro and tokenizer dumps (hex + token ids)? Also the exact quant flags used.

Tom: Repro run: `./onboard --model silkroad-v1 --quant q4f --calib per_channel --quant-hash=fnv --dataset srt-multilang --langs ja,zh,ar,he --detok unicode --batch 8`
Example: FP16 detok: "\u7ae0\u30d5\u30ea\u30ac\u30ca" (kanji+furigana). q4f detok: "\u7ae0\u00A0\u30d5\u30ea\u30ac\u30ca" (NBSP inserted). Another sample shows `()` bracket mirrored in Hebrew fragment only on q4f.

Samir: Paste the tokenizer dump for one failing line. If the token ids include 0x00A0 or 0x200C inserted under q4f that's a compaction assignment problem.

Tom: Dump: `fp16 ids: [0x5f20,0x30d5,0x30ea,0x30ac,0x30ca]` vs `q4f ids: [0x5f20,0x00A0,0x30d5,0x30ea,0x30ac,0x30ca]`. Raw bytes show 0xC2 0xA0 between han+kana when Arabic/Hebrew occurs later in sentence.

Aiko: Try `--tokenizer-normalize=NFKC` and `--preserve_whitespace=false` to isolate normalizer toggles. Also regen quant table with `--quant-hash=xxh3 --quant-salt=13` to test collision hypothesis.

Tom: Quick tests: `NFKC` removes many NBSP cases but BLEU still ~2-3 down. `preserve_whitespace=false` removes the NBSP but introduces kana splits. Regenerated q4f with xxh3+salt=13 on one worker and NBSP disappeared in sampled lines; bracket mirroring also fixed. Filing BUG-ml-7201 with repro + tokenmap_q4f.json.

Samir: If hash+salt flips behavior it's almost certainly compaction collision. Add a small deterministic mixed-script sample (kanji+furigana + RTL snippet) to the quant smoke harness and gate q4f auto-promote until we confirm regen stable.

eval-bot: Snapshot (srt-multilang subset): fp16 BLEU 39.8 chrF 0.599 | q4f BLEU 34.6 chrF 0.558 | q4f(regen xxh3+13) BLEU 38.9 chrF 0.592 | delta best-regen vs fp16: -0.9

Aiko: Nice triage. Let's standardize xxh3+salt for compaction and add the mixed-script unit. Also add a short deterministic perturbation test (tiny noise before compaction) to detect brittle clustering.

Tom: Done — added test and gated silkroad-v1_q4f. Will follow up once CI grid finishes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
